name: OpenClaw Process Message Plugin
description: Installable OpenClaw plugin package for message processing helpers.

defaultPrefix.description: Optional prefix added to every processed message.

trimByDefault.description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace before formatting.

collapseWhitespace.description: Collapse repeated whitespace to a single space.

metaField.description: Top-level field name used to store plugin-generated history metadata.

rewriteRoles.description: Message roles whose persisted structure should be rewritten.

blockRoles.description: Message roles that should be skipped entirely during transcript persistence.

redactTopLevelFields.description: Top-level message fields removed before persistence.

trimTextContent.description: Trim string and text-block content before writing the transcript.

includeStoredAt.description: Include a storedAt timestamp in the generated metadata field.

includeSessionRef.description: Include sessionKey in the generated metadata field when available.

includeAgentId.description: Include agentId in the generated metadata field when available.

dropToolResultDetails.description: Remove toolResult.details before the message is written to history.

annotateSyntheticToolResults.description: Record whether a persisted tool result was synthesized by the guard layer.

aggregateToolResultsByAssistant.description: Link persisted toolResult metadata back to assistant messages by toolCallId.

includeAssistantAggregationOnAssistant.description: Attach assistant aggregation metadata to persisted assistant messages.

includeAssistantAggregationOnToolResult.description: Attach linked assistant aggregation metadata to persisted toolResult messages.

aggregateAssistantTextLimit.description: Maximum characters stored for assistant and toolResult text previews.

aggregateAssistantMaxItems.description: Maximum tool calls or linked tool results retained in assistant aggregation metadata.

aggregateConversationRounds.description: Build latest-round conversation summaries from user, assistant, and toolResult messages.

injectLatestRoundIntoPrompt.description: Inject the latest completed conversation-round summary into before_prompt_build.
